sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home, Lucknow And Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Sheo Prakash Singh,Mahendra Pratap Singh

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
None turned up on behalf of the complainant despite service of notice.

2. The FIR in question was lodged on 30.03.2024 alleging that on 23.03.2024, the informant, who is also the victim aged about 17 years was at her home, when the applicant and caught hold of her and misbehaved with her.

No allegation of rape was leveled against the applicant, subsequently however,
in the statement under Section 161 & 164 Cr.P.C., the victim alleged that she was taken to a Jungle and rape was committed on her.
The medical on record does not corroborate any of the allegation.
The tentative age of the victim is around 17 years.

sentences.text: 3. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.

4. Considering the inordinate delay in lodging the FIR and the two statements not supported by any material whatsoever, a case for bail is made out, the applicant who is in custody since 24.04.2024 and has no criminal history is enlarged on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Shiv Karan be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 113 of 2024, under Sections 376, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Sareni, District Raebareli, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
